raw_quote: If memory matters and the caller explicitly allows overwriting the map, land can be changed from "1" to "0" when discovered. Later checks then treat claimed land like water, replacing the separate `seen` matrix. The stack can still require `O(mn)` space, and callers lose the original map. Copying first to preserve it restores `O(mn)` copy storage; copying only the outer list shares the original row lists and does not protect their entries.
